name: maknaz
description: MAKNAZ MVP monorepo: React web app, Express API, shared domain package.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @maknaz/api" "npm run dev -w @maknaz/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @maknaz/shared && npm run build -w @maknaz/api && npm run build -w @maknaz/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @maknaz/shared && npm run test -w @maknaz/api && npm run test -w @maknaz/web
